sloka: आजगामथ सुग्रीवो यत्र रामः सलक्ष्मणः ।ततश्चाख्यातुमारेभे विभीषणवचः शुभम् ॥६-१९-३३॥।।
transliteration: ājagāmatha sugrīvo yatra rāmaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ ।tataścākhyātumārebhe vibhīṣaṇavacaḥ śubham ॥6-19-33॥।।

translations.english: "O best of Vanaras Sugriva Either Vibheeshana or any one by himself and even Ravana who is unprotected thus seeks security from me, I will offer protection."
